native.ms_edition: Actual selected standard and revision;1553A/B or enhanced rate extensions require their own registered revision, not silent C equivalence.
native.ms_application: Actual basic C scope versus AppendixA.2 Army/Navy/AirForce dual-standby restrictions; industry selection does not choose this profile.
native.ms_role: Actual terminal acting as bus controller, remote terminal or passive monitor; only BC initiates command ownership.
native.ms_message: Actual Figure6/7 command/response transfer format; application group names do not define broadcast.
native.ms_condition: Actual normal completed transfer versus busy transmitter status-only reply; invalid commands/data require separate behavior evidence.
native.ms_coupling: Actual transformer versus direct stub at this terminal. Spec electrical limits depend on test point and coupling.
native.ms_redundancy: Actual single, dual standby or separately qualified multiple path architecture; dual links are not concurrent aggregate throughput.
native.ms_stub_policy: Recommended short stub envelope versus documented installed longer exception allowed by4.5.1.5; no guessed bus length.
native.ms_encoding: ManchesterII bi-phase level, logic1positive/negative and0negative/positive; no CAN bit stuffing.
native.ms_bit_order: MSB first within data word and highest precision word first; quantities can be bit packed.
native.ms_parity: Odd parity over sixteen information bits, excluding three-bit sync waveform.
native.ms_measurement_point: Actual electrical/timing observation: terminal stubA versus loaded terminal test fixtureA versus transformerB; these are not interchangeable.
native.ms_receiver_region: Actual valid-input versus required no-response low-level region; intermediate region has no guaranteed response.
native.ms_power_state: Actual transmit, receive/power-off or startup/shutdown; different noise tests apply.
native.ms_revision: Actual standard edition, installed terminal revision, options and applicable AppendixA.2 scope.
native.ms_registered_source: Actual independently registered edition/application/redundancy schema, not a rate guess.
native.ms_binding_source: Actual canonical BC/RT/BM identities, active bus, unique address map and physical ownership.
native.ms_device_source: Actual terminal implemented subaddresses/counts/mode/status/broadcast/self-test and failsafe hardware capabilities.
native.ms_encoding_source: Actual complete command/data/status codec, packed signal bits, unused zero bits, sync and odd-parity qualification.
native.ms_schedule_source: Actual controller command schedule, periods, response and no-response paths, retry/bus switch traffic; C specifies no universal retry count.
native.ms_physical_source: Actual cable/termination/stub/coupler/connector/load/fault topology and worst-case signal integrity.
native.ms_measurement_source: Actual calibrated test points, fixture loads, frequency/amplitude/temperature and measured bounds.
native.ms_capacity_source: Actual full message sequence including both RT responses, gap references, BC ownership, failures and retries.
native.ms_acceptance_source: Actual functional E2E/freshness/safety acceptance; odd parity and800us hardware timeout do not prove application safety.
native.ms_stub_exception_source: Actual signal integrity and fault qualification for a longer-than-recommended stub.
native.ms_redundancy_source: Actual isolated alternate paths, single-event routing and allowed bus handover behavior.
native.ms_command_bus_id: Actual bus carrying this command, not arbitrary A/B default.
native.ms_target_bus_id: Actual redundant transmitter affected by shutdown/override; must differ from command bus.
native.ms_mode_source: Actual RT support for this mode and associated data word; reserved modes cannot be redefined.
native.ms_emc_source: Actual applicable MIL-STD-464 edition and EMC qualification; this profile does not implement that external test standard.
native.ms_noise_test_source: Actual continuous random-word AWGN test and TableII acceptance/rejection record, not a reliability probability default.
native.ms_address_wiring_source: Actual AppendixA.2 external address wiring, power-up validation and single-point-failure protection.
native.ms_wrap_source: Actual wrap-around receive/transmit buffers and no-intervening-command sequence qualification.
native.ms_observed_bitrate_bps: Actual measured information bit clock999000..1001000; nominal1M and short-term stability are distinct.
native.ms_short_stability_hz: Actual magnitude of one-second short-term clock stability, at most100Hz; not an arbitrary ppm default.
native.ms_word_info_bits: Sixteen information bits in each command/data/status word.
native.ms_sync_bit_times: Invalid Manchester sync spans three bit times; it is not three ordinary data bits.
native.ms_parity_bits: One odd parity bit per word.
native.ms_word_bit_times: Twenty serialized bit times per word including sync and parity.
native.ms_command_address: Actual five-bit first receive/mode command target;31 only broadcast and never a unique RT.
native.ms_source_rt_address: Actual unique transmitting RT address for RT_BC/RT_RT/RT_BROADCAST, not31.
native.ms_subaddress: Actual five-bit subaddress;0/31 exclusively mode control,1..30 data, no default installed address.
native.ms_tr_bit: Actual first command transmit/receive bit:0receive,1transmit; mode meanings follow TableI.
native.ms_requested_data_words: Actual normal command count1..32; encoded count0means32, never zero data.
native.ms_count_code: Actual five-bit data count field for non-mode commands, not a CAN DLC.
native.ms_data_words: Actual serialized data words, excluding command/status; busy transmitter or no-data mode can carry0.
native.ms_mode_code: Actual TableI defined mode;9..15/22..31 reserved and unavailable.
native.ms_command_words: Actual one BC command, or two contiguous commands for RT-to-RT formats.
native.ms_status_words: Actual response count; receiving broadcast RTs suppress status but transmitting RT still responds.
native.ms_response_count: Actual RT turnaround intervals: RT_RTnormal2,RTbroadcast1,BCbroadcast0; no Ethernet ACK heuristic.
native.ms_total_words: Actual sum of command/data/status words, before sync/parity expansion.
native.ms_wire_bit_times: Actual20times totalwords; Manchester transitions do not double this information bit clock.
native.ms_data_octets: Actual two encoded data octets per serialized data word; not application payload guarantee.
native.ms_response1_us: Actual first RT response midpoint-to-mid-sync at that RT pointA,4..12us. It is not idle duration or E2E latency.
native.ms_response2_us: Actual second receiving-RT response for normal RT_RT only,4..12us at that RTpointA.
native.ms_intermessage_gap_us: Actual last parity mid-bit to next command mid-sync at BCpointA,at least4us; excludes neither propagation nor reference offsets automatically.
native.ms_no_response_timeout_us: Actual terminal no-response wait,at least14us from its own last parity midpoint to expected status midsync; not500ms scenario timeout.
native.ms_hardware_failsafe_us: Actual implemented transmitter hardware timeout no greater800us and must permit correct commanded transmission.
native.ms_active_controllers: Only one terminal in active control of each bus at a time; backup BCs are not simultaneous arbiters.
native.ms_bus_count: Actual physical redundant paths, independent from connected terminal count.
native.ms_active_bus_count: Normal dual-standby behavior has one active path; superseding commands are separately qualified exceptions.
native.ms_interbus_isolation_db: Measured active-to-inactive terminal output isolation at fixtureA,at least45dB.
native.ms_retry_attempts: Actual controller retry policy count from workload/schedule; no standard universalzero/three.
native.ms_retry_delay_us: Actual controller retry/bus switch timing from schedule,not CAN retry or exponential IPbackoff.
native.ms_instrumentation_bit: Status instrumentation bit always zero, including when option unused.
native.ms_reserved_status_bits: Three status reserved bits always zero.
native.ms_cable_nominal_ohm: Selected cable nominal differential impedance70..85ohm at1MHz,not universal78ohm.
native.ms_cable_actual_ohm: Actual measured differential impedance70..85ohm for AppendixA.2 at1MHz.
native.ms_cable_pf_ft: Actual wire-to-wire distributed cable capacitance no greater30pF/ft.
native.ms_termination_ohm: Actual end termination within selected nominalZo+-2percent; neither a universal120ohm nor78ohm.
native.ms_termination_count: Both main cable ends are terminated.
native.ms_stub_ft: Actual stub length including internal cable;recommended transformer<=20ft/direct<=1ft, qualified longer exceptions allowed.
native.ms_fault_impedance_ohm: Actual failed-branch reflected bus load>=1.5Zo for transformer or110ohm direct.
native.ms_turns_ratio: Actual high-turn isolation-resistor side to low-turn ratio1.41+-3percent,not1:1.
native.ms_transformer_open_ohm: Coupling transformerB open-circuit impedance strictly>3000ohm at75kHz..1MHz,1Vrms sine.
native.ms_transformer_droop_percent: TransformerB droop<=20percent at250kHz27Vpp square input and360ohm+-5percent fixture.
native.ms_transformer_ringing_v: Magnitude of transformerB overshoot/ringing strictly<1Vpeak in specified test.
native.ms_transformer_cmrr_db: Coupling transformer common-mode rejection strictly>45dB at1MHz.
native.ms_fixture_ohm: Actual terminal fixture load70ohm+-2percent transformer or35ohm+-2percent direct.
native.ms_stub_vpp: Actual loaded installed stubA voltage:transformer1..14Vpp,direct1.4..20Vpp including fault/worstTX.
native.ms_tx_crossing_ns: Magnitude of transmitter zero-crossing deviation from previous ideal crossing<=25ns.
native.ms_tx_ringing_mv: Magnitude of fixtureA transmitter distortion<=900mVpeak transformer/300direct.
native.ms_off_noise_mvrms: Receiving or power-off fixtureA noise<=14mVrms transformer/5direct.
native.ms_symmetry_mv: Magnitude of residual output2.5us after parity midpoint,<=250mVpeak transformer/90direct; six specified patterns up to33words.
native.ms_rx_vpp: Actual input amplitude at stubA with response/no-response region; unknown intermediate region is not guaranteed.
native.ms_rx_crossing_ns: Magnitude of acceptable input zero-crossing deviation<=150ns.
native.ms_rx_common_mode_v: Qualified peak input line-to-ground common mode tolerance at least10V overDC..2MHz.
native.ms_noise_awgn_mvrms: Actual prescribed AWGN test140mVrms transformer/200direct over1kHz..4MHz.
native.ms_noise_input_vpp: Actual prescribed noise-test input2.1Vpp transformer/3Vpp direct atstubA.
native.ms_noise_word_error_rate: Qualified maximum word error rate1e-7 under prescribed AWGN test; not universal undetected-bit risk or application reliability.
native.ms_reset_bound_ms: Actual AppendixA.2 reset complete within5ms after status parity midpoint; not universal operating-cycle default.
native.ms_self_test_bound_ms: Actual AppendixA.2 implemented initiate-self-test completion/results within100ms.
native.ms_rt_rt_validation_us: Actual AppendixA.2 receiving RT first-data validation threshold57+-3us referenced to receive-command parity midpoint.
native.ms_wrap_subaddress: Actual implemented wrap-around subaddress1..30;30is desired,not an assigned installed address.
native.ms_broadcast_supported: Actual destination RT implements broadcast; not inferred from data multicast labels.
native.ms_dynamic_control_supported: Actual RT supports offered control and acceptance bit; handover occurs after its status completes.
native.ms_address_valid: Actual external address validated at power-up for AppendixA.2;false prevents any RT response.
native.ms_required_modes_supported: Actual AppendixA.2 RT minimum2/4/5/8mode capability and BC all TableI modes.
native.ms_minimum_formats_supported: Actual AppendixA.2 required RT data+mode formats and BC allformats.
native.ms_busy_bit: Actual status busy condition; busy transmitting RT sends only status, no requested data.
native.ms_message_error_bit: Actual word/count/continuity error state; invalid receive data suppresses status and invalidates whole message.
native.ms_broadcast_received_bit: Actual previous validated command broadcast state; not a confirmation of all receivers.
native.ms_service_request_bit: Actual implemented exception service request; ORed subsystem requests need separate identifying data.
native.ms_subsystem_flag: Actual associated subsystem fault, not a generated safety assurance.
native.ms_terminal_flag: Actual RT self-test/fault indication,not application data validity proof.
native.ms_dynamic_control_acceptance: Actual control offer accepted/rejected in status; unsupported function staysfalse.
native.ms_dual_terminal_connectors: Actual Navy AppendixA.2 both transformer/direct external connectors capability.
native.ms_positive_center_pin: Actual AppendixA.2 concentric connector center pin carries positive Manchester and ring negative.
native.ms_failsafe_hardware: Actual hardware implemented transmitter timeout, not software-only assumption.
native.ms_unused_bits_zero: Actual every unused information bit encodedzero, including bit-packed signals.
native.bitrate: Nominal1Mbit/s for actualMIL-STD-1553C2018, distinct observed999000..1001000 and one-second100Hzstability. Conditional source-qualified proposal, never Ethernet/CAN mode fallback or commissioned confirmation.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application encoded bytes fit two octets per actual data word1..32, at most64. Mode words manage bus hardware rather than application payload; busy transmitting RT emits status only. Word sync/parity and command/status are separate.
